mailbox.question: Dear Farmer
mailbox.write: Write a letter to a distant farmer
write.title: Dear Farmer
write.hint: Write something kind, honest or silly. It will land in a random farmer's mailbox, somewhere in the world.
write.sent: Your letter is on its way!
write.remaining: You can send {{count}} more letter(s) today.
write.remaining.none: You've sent all your letters for today. Try again tomorrow.
write.rules: No links, no personal info, be kind. Letters are anonymous and can be voted on by whoever receives them.
read.header: A letter from a distant farmer
read.offline: Could not reach the Dear Farmer server. Your vote will not be counted.
list.received.title: Letters I've received
list.mine.title: Letters I've written
list.empty.received: No letters yet. Keep checking your mailbox!
list.empty.mine: You haven't written any letters yet.
hud.delivered: A letter from a distant farmer arrived in your mailbox!
hud.sent: Letter sent! It will reach another farmer's mailbox soon.
error.network: Could not reach the Dear Farmer server. Check your connection and try again.
error.rateLimited: You've sent too many letters recently. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
error.outdated: Your Dear Farmer mod is outdated. Please update it.
error.banned: Your account was blocked from Dear Farmer.
error.dailyLimit: You've already sent {{max}} letters today (game days). Come back tomorrow!
config.apiBaseUrl.name: Server URL
config.apiBaseUrl.tooltip: Address of the Dear Farmer backend (Cloudflare Worker).
config.lettersPerDay.name: Letters delivered per day
config.lettersPerDay.tooltip: How many letters from other farmers arrive in your mailbox each in-game day.
config.maxSentPerDay.name: Letters you can send per day
config.maxSentPerDay.tooltip: Maximum letters you can write per in-game day (the server also limits per real hour).
config.signWithName.name: Sign letters with my farmer name
config.openMenuKey.name: Open Dear Farmer key
config.openMenuKey.tooltip: Opens the Dear Farmer menu from anywhere (the mailbox also works).
config.showHudMessage.name: Show HUD message on delivery
config.deliverOnlyWhenMailboxEmpty.name: Deliver only when no game mail is pending
config.deliverOnlyWhenMailboxEmpty.toolt: Avoid mixing Dear Farmer letters with important game mail on the same day.
design.title: Letter design
design.sample: Hello, distant farmer! I hope your crops are growing and the rain is kind to you this season. Here's a little something to brighten your day.
paint.hint: Drag on the letter to paint. Keys: P pencil, L line, B bucket, E eraser, 1-3 size, Ctrl+Z undo. The drawing travels with your letters; drawings reported by readers are removed and block you from drawing for a while.
error.drawingBlocked: Your letter was sent without the drawing: a recent drawing of yours was reported, so drawing is paused for a while.
config.showDrawings.name: Show drawings from other players
config.showDrawings.tooltip: Turn off to receive letters as text and stickers only (useful for kids or if you prefer not to see freehand drawings).
